name: Awsenumer
description: AWS enumeration: identity, S3 buckets (+public-read check), IAM roles/users, EC2 instances, Secrets Manager names, Lambda functions. Requires aws CLI with valid credentials.

aws_enum.description: Full AWS enumeration (identity, S3, IAM, EC2, Secrets, Lambda).

parameters.full: true for full scan, false for identity+S3 only

aws_s3.description: List S3 buckets and check public-read ACLs.

aws_secrets.description: List Secrets Manager names (values NOT read).
